subject.title: fix(openai): add timeout to realtime client-secret requests

question: Should OpenAI Realtime secret minting adopt the maintained 30-second HTTP smoke budget as an absolute production cutoff?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but accepting that exceptionally slow requests will now fail after 30 seconds is an intentional compatibility choice rather than a correctness fact automation can decide.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Land the aligned deadline because interactive Realtime setup should fail within the maintained HTTP smoke budget rather than wait for the multi-minute transport timeout.

options.title: Choose a longer fixed budget
options.body: Revise the constant if maintainers have production evidence that valid OpenAI secret requests commonly need more than 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Land the aligned deadline because interactive Realtime setup should fail within the maintained HTTP smoke budget rather than wait for the multi-minute transport timeout.
